evidence.evidence_text: First, we introduce a novel dataset, Tell2Design (T2D), which contains more than 80k floor plan designs associated with natural language instructions.
We consider the task of generating designs directly from natural language descriptions, and consider floor plan generation as the initial research area.
Second, we propose a Sequence-to-Sequence model that can serve as a strong baseline for future research.
